title: kate-ui: record the gutter columns for one line
summary: gutter_row records the 1-based line number, the modified flag, the fold marker, and the mark flag. paint.rs stays unchanged. The test goes in the existing keys tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn gutter_row(line: u32, modified: bool, fold: Option<FoldMark>, marked: bool) -> GutterRow

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: keys.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add FoldMark, GutterRow, and gutter_row. Keep the enum and the struct public. Keep gutter_row public. Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] on gutter_row. number is line.saturating_add(1). The other fields are the arguments. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch command_for_binding, caret_marks, or selection_spans. Do not edit paint.rs. The existing test meta_and_command_are_cmd stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test gutter_row_records_the_four_columns checks gutter_row of line 0, modified true, Some(FoldMark::Closed), and marked true. The number is 1, modified is true, fold is Closed, and marked is true. gutter_row of line 8, modified false, None, and marked false has number 9, modified false, fold None, and marked false. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::gutter_row_records_the_four_columns
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because gutter_row does not exist. After the change line 0 with a closed fold is number 1. Line 8 with no flags is number 9.
